en.headline: Red rainstorm warning issued; afternoon school classes cancelled
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory raised the red rainstorm signal at 11.05 am on Friday; the Education Bureau said students of PM schools need not attend classes this afternoon.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory issued the Red Rainstorm Warning Signal at 11.05 am on Friday, warning that heavy rain exceeding 50 millimetres in an hour had fallen or was expected to fall generally over Hong Kong and was likely to continue.

The Education Bureau announced that students of afternoon schools do not have to attend school this afternoon. Schools should keep premises open and implement contingency measures for any students who arrive. Schools already in session should continue until the end of normal hours and ensure conditions are safe before allowing students to return home.

A Thunderstorm Warning remained in force, with squally thunderstorms and gusts of 80 kilometres per hour or above possible. The Observatory advised people to stay away from watercourses and to listen for further announcements on traffic and flooding risks.

The Labour Department reminded employers to prioritise employee safety under rainstorm warnings, while the Home Affairs Department opened temporary shelters for those in need. Social Welfare Department centres for young children and the elderly remained open.

zh.headline: 紅色暴雨警告生效 教育局：下午校學生今日無需上課
zh.dek: 天文台於上午11時05分發出紅色暴雨警告信號；教育局宣布下午校學生今日無需上課，學校須繼續開放照顧已到校學生。
body: 香港天文台今日上午11時05分發出紅色暴雨警告信號，指本港已有或預料普遍地區會錄得每小時超過50毫米的大雨，並可能持續。
教育局宣布，下午校學生今日無需上課。學校應繼續開放校舍，並採取應變措施照顧已到校的學生。正在上課的學校應繼續至正常放學時間，並確保環境安全才讓學生回家。
雷暴警告仍然生效，預料有狂風雷暴，陣風或達每小時80公里或以上。天文台呼籲市民遠離河道，並留意最新交通及水浸消息。
勞工處提醒僱主在暴雨警告下優先考慮僱員安全；民政事務總署已為有需要人士開放臨時庇護中心；社署表示幼兒中心及長者服務中心等繼續開放。
